name: fmp_cash_flow
description:
Cash flow statements for one company from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/cash-flow-statement): operating, investing and financing cash flows, free cash flow, capex, dividends paid, one record per period.
Returns {symbol, period, statements}: statements is the list of FMP period records.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased), period (annual or quarter; default annual), limit (integer 1-100, number of periods; default 5).
Sibling statements: fmp_income_statement and fmp_balance_sheet; owner earnings: fmp_owner_earnings.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "GOOGL", "period": "annual", "limit": 5}

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)
